necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome, superimposed on a background of atherosclerotic heart disease. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of the conduction abnormalities. This service addresses the specific clinical need to evaluate the diagnosed conditions I47.1, I25.10, and I49.5.
